+++ b/tests/test_filter_logic.py
@@ -0,0 +1,74 @@
+
+import ast
+
+def evaluate_filter(node, user):
+    if isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
+        return node.value
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.Name):
+        if node.id in user:
+            return user[node.id]
+        raise ValueError(f"Unknown variable: {node.id}")
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.Compare):
+        left = evaluate_filter(node.left, user)
+        if len(node.ops) != 1:
+            raise ValueError("Only single comparison supported")
+        right = evaluate_filter(node.comparators[0], user)
+        op = node.ops[0]
+        if isinstance(op, ast.Eq): return left == right
+        if isinstance(op, ast.NotEq): return left != right
+        if isinstance(op, ast.Lt): return left < right
+        if isinstance(op, ast.LtE): return left <= right
+        if isinstance(op, ast.Gt): return left > right
+        if isinstance(op, ast.GtE): return left >= right
+        raise ValueError(f"Unknown operator: {type(op)}")
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.BoolOp):
+        values = [evaluate_filter(v, user) for v in node.values]
+        if isinstance(node.op, ast.And):
+            return all(values)
+        if isinstance(node.op, ast.Or):
+            return any(values)
+        raise ValueError(f"Unknown boolean operator: {type(node.op)}")
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp):
+        if isinstance(node.op, ast.Not):
+            return not evaluate_filter(node.operand, user)
+        raise ValueError(f"Unknown unary operator: {type(node.op)}")
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported node type: {type(node)}")
+
+def validate_node(node):
+    if isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
+        return
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.Name):
+        if node.id not in ['id', 'name', 'email']:
+            raise ValueError(f"Unknown field: {node.id}")
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.Compare):
+        validate_node(node.left)
+        for comp in node.comparators:
+            validate_node(comp)
+        if not all(isinstance(op, (ast.Eq, ast.NotEq, ast.Lt, ast.LtE, ast.Gt, ast.GtE)) for op in node.ops):
+             raise ValueError("Unsupported comparison operator")
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.BoolOp):
+        if not isinstance(node.op, (ast.And, ast.Or)):
+            raise ValueError("Unsupported boolean operator")
+        for v in node.values:
+            validate_node(v)
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp):
+        if not isinstance(node.op, ast.Not):
+            raise ValueError("Unsupported unary operator")
+        validate_node(node.operand)
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported node type: {type(node)}")
+
+def test_filter(expression, user):
+    tree = ast.parse(expression, mode='eval')
+    validate_node(tree.body)
+    return evaluate_filter(tree.body, user)
+
+# Tests
+user1 = {"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"}
+print(test_filter("name == 'Ada'", user1))
+print(test_filter("id > 0 and email != 'x@y.org'", user1))
+try:
+    print(test_filter("name.upper() == 'ADA'", user1))
+except Exception as e:
+    print(e)

+from app.api.handlers import handle_filter_users

+def test_filter_users():

+    code, res = handle_filter_users({"where": "id > 0 and name != 'Linus'"})

+    assert len(res["users"]) == 1
+    assert res["users"][0]["name"] == "Ada"
+
+    # Missing filter
+    code, res = handle_filter_users({})
+    assert code == 400
+    assert res["error"] == "invalid filter"
+
+    # Invalid filter
+    code, res = handle_filter_users({"where": "name.upper() == 'ADA'"})
+    assert code == 400
+    assert res["error"] == "invalid filter"
+
+    # Invalid filter type
+    code, res = handle_filter_users({"where": 123})
+    assert code == 400
+    assert res["error"] == "invalid filter"
+    
+    # Valid filter (or)
+    code, res = handle_filter_users({"where": "id == 1 or id == 2"})
+    assert code == 200
+    assert len(res["users"]) == 2
